standard: PCI DSS v4.0.1 Req. 12.3.3 — cryptographic cipher suites and protocols in use: documented and reviewed at least once every 12 months

protocols.name: TLS 1.3
protocols.notes: preferred when the peer supports it

protocols.name: TLS 1.1
protocols.notes: insecure version; must not be negotiated

protocols.name: TLS 1.0
protocols.notes: insecure version; must not be negotiated

protocols.name: SSL 3.0 / 2.0
protocols.notes: disabled in libcurl/OpenSSL builds Northgate supports

monitoring: NIST SP 800-52r2, PCI SSC bulletins, OpenSSL advisories reviewed quarterly by @northgate/security-eng
response_plan: Protocol/suite deprecations are handled as a security release of the SDK (MIN_TLS_VERSION / CURLOPT_SSL_CIPHER_LIST) with 90 days' merchant notice.
